title: Probabilistic Topology Filters: Invariant-Preserving Bloom Structures for Chronos-Topology Graph Engines
author: Mateus Yonathan

abstract: Efficient membership testing is a core requirement for graph traversal and network flow engines that operate over large, dynamic topologies. We introduce a Bloom-filter--based structure integrated into the Chronos-Topology framework, designed to preserve key invariants while offering sub-linear space overhead. The filter employs deterministic djb2 and sdbm hash functions combined with a double-hashing scheme, guaranteeing that every inserted element is reported present (no false negatives) and bounding the false-positive rate by a user-specified parameter. We formally prove the invariant preservation property and analyze the asymptotic complexity of the filter operations, showing $O(1)$ expected time per query and $O(n)$ construction time for $n$ expected items. The implementation is written in C and verified through static abstract syntax tree inspection and formal invariant proofs. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/c-lowlevel-systems/tree/main/algorithms/20261114_190239_probabilistic_data_structures}
